answer: Watch the tide, not the shells. Any single account can dress itself anew, so the protocol draws an atlas of associations instead: who funds alongside whom, who votes in the same minute, who keeps the same sleeping pattern. Correlations are computed slowly and merged - strongly linked accounts share one bundle of voting weight. A sybil farm can rename every yarrow-scented stranger it breeds, but it cannot make ten thousand shells that wake, spend, and vanish in unison into ten separate weather systems; they read as one tide seen from many shores.
